title: CIO Greatest Hits: Endowments – Andy Golden (Princo)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Our Summer Series kickoff is a twofer, Andy Golden, now retired after thirty years at Princeton University Investment Management Company.
reader_summary.overview: Our Summer Series kickoff is a twofer, Andy Golden, now retired after thirty years at Princeton University Investment Management Company, and Scott Wilson from Washington University-St. We packaged these two leading endowments to compare their investment styles. Andy started his career at Yale with me and became one of the leaders of the endowment model for decades.

key_points.text: His discussion of Princo's decision-making process is among the most referenced descriptions of any podcast with a CIO.
